title: Curious by nature.
description: About 111iridescence: macOS app development, cybersecurity, systems, and building with artificial intelligence.
intro: I have been interested in computers since childhood. After earning a higher-education degree in computer science with a cybersecurity specialization, I am now pursuing a Master’s degree in cybersecurity. Outside my studies, I build macOS applications and experiment with systems, networks, and my own servers.

sections.title: macOS development.
sections.body: I build tools that solve concrete problems. I work mainly with Rust and native macOS technologies, with particular attention to simplicity, performance, and interface design.

sections.title: Cybersecurity.
sections.body: My Master’s degree extends my interest in cryptography, systems, networks, protocols, IoT, traffic analysis, and digital forensics. I like understanding how a system works, how it can fail, and how it can be better protected.

sections.title: Systems and homelab.
sections.body: I use Linux, macOS, Windows, Docker, and virtualization. My homelab is where I test self-hosted services, network configurations, and automations.

sections.title: AI is part of the process.
sections.body: I rely heavily on artificial intelligence when developing my projects. It helps me prototype, generate code, understand new technologies, compare solutions, and fix problems. I do not claim to write every line myself: my role is to shape the idea, define the expected result, test what is produced, and improve it until the whole thing works properly.

sections.title: My applications.
sections.body: 111iridescence is the name under which I publish the applications and tools I want to share.

sections.title: What comes next.
sections.body: I keep learning and improving my projects. You can explore my applications here or follow their development on GitHub.
